description.en: The destination Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR) block of the route entry.
The ID of the next hop.

description.zh:
自定义路由条目的下一跳的类型，取值：
- Instance（默认值）：ENS实例。
- HaVip：高可用虚拟 IP。
- NetworkPeer：网络对等连接。
description.en:
The type of next hop of the custom route entry. Valid values:

- Instance (default): an ENS instance.

- HaVip: a high-availability virtual IP address (HAVIP).

- NetworkPeer: VPC peering connection.

description.zh: 查询列表的页码。取值：>0，默认查询第1页。
description.en: The page number of the returned page. Valid values: integers that are greater than 0. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。默认值：10，取值：10~100。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Valid values: 10 to 100.
The ID of the route that you want to query.

description.zh:
路由条目的类型。取值：
- Custom：自定义路由。
- System：系统路由。
description.en:
The route type. Valid values:

- Custom: custom route

- System: system route
The ID of the route table that you want to query.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens describe-ens-route-entry-list --route-table-id vtb-hp3wdhynneo7fsclox8hs --route-entry-id rte-8vbdw66evgv44u2u7v3hx --destination-cidr-block 11.0.0.0/16 --route-entry-type Custom --next-hop-type Instance --next-hop-id i-2zecshuv3axtr2gc4noa --route-entry-name test0 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens DescribeEnsRouteEntryList --region cn-hangzhou --RouteEntryId 'rte-8vbdw66evgv44u2u7v3hx' --NextHopType Instance --RouteTableId 'vtb-hp3wdhynneo7fsclox8hs' --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --RouteEntryType Custom --RouteEntryName test0 --NextHopId 'i-2zecshuv3axtr2gc4noa' --DestinationCidrBlock '11.0.0.0/16'
